title: CodeBlock
description: A read-only block of preformatted text (logs, payloads, config) in a named, keyboard-focusable scroll region.

basic.title: Basic usage
basic.description: Text is rendered verbatim and long lines wrap by default.

no-wrap.title: Scrolling logs
no-wrap.description: wrap={false} keeps lines intact and scrolls horizontally; maxHeight bounds the block.

CodeBlockProps.ariaLabel: Accessible name of the code region
CodeBlockProps.wrap: Wraps long lines instead of scrolling horizontally
CodeBlockProps.maxHeight: Maximum height before the block scrolls
CodeBlockProps.tabIndex: Tab order of the region (focusable by default)
